stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[5].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

field_syntax.statement: Five fields accept *, comma lists, ranges and steps (*/n, a-b/n, a/n); out-of-range values, step 0, reversed ranges, malformed tokens and a field count other than 5 are rejected.

names.statement: JAN-DEC and SUN-SAT are accepted case-insensitively in single values, lists and ranges; unknown names are rejected; day-of-week 7 equals Sunday.

validate_cli.statement: validate exits 0 and prints one explanation line per field for a valid expression; for an invalid one it exits 1 and the message names the offending field.
must_include: validate explains each field or reports the error

next_cli.statement: next -n N prints exactly N run times strictly after the given now, ascending, each matching the expression; default N=1; N<1 is a usage error.
must_include: next -n N run times from now

invalid_dates.statement: February 30 and April 31 are never produced, February 29 only in leap years, and an expression that can never match (0 0 30 2 *) is reported as an error with exit 1 by both validate and next.

dom_dow_or.statement: With both day-of-month and day-of-week restricted a date matches if either matches; with one of them * only the restricted one applies.

single_file_stdlib.statement: cron_parser.py imports only standard library modules and runs as a script with no sibling module.
